atOmpReport.question: why does the chat box show @omp when OMP is the only agent
atOmpReport.root: the session/participant handle in apps/macos/package.json is literally `omp` (chatSessions[0].name and the participant), and the base renders handles with an @ leader
paths: a chat locked to our session type falls back to the base's delegation copy: title 'Delegate to @omp', message 'This chat session will be forwarded to the @omp coding agent where work is completed in the background.' (chatWidget.ts getWelcomeViewContent, used when the contribution has no welcomeTitle/welcomeMessage)
mention completions render participants as @name; today the composer's @ list is the base's Copilot tools (@agent, @browser, @askQuestions, @runSubagent, ...)
atOmpReport.relatedFinding: listed sessions are bound as caret://session/<id> and getChatSessionType() returns the URI scheme, so their type is `caret` while the contribution's type is `caret.omp`; getChatSessionContribution('caret') misses, the widget stays unlocked (every listed session shows 'Build with Agent'), and the contribution's own copy, placeholder and capabilities never apply. Chats created for the type (scheme = type) are the ones that lock.
atOmpReport.reproduced: no @omp string was found on screen in any state this pass could drive (every listed session, the Agent Home, a fresh window) - a screenshot of the state where the user saw it would pin the surface
